_readme: Themes (and optional difficulty) for each queued mystery picture, so the
weekly bake can tag it. A queued image with no usable entry here is left
in the queue and never baked — that is how no mystery ever ships untagged.
Key: the picture's id — the queued filename with its date prefix and
extension removed, then slugified. For 2026-08-24-koi-in-the-rain.jpg the
themes      1-3 labels; the common ones are Abstract, Animals, Fantasy,
Flowers, Food, Landscape, Space, Spooky, Water, but any label works
and grows its own filter category (e.g. Trees). Spelling is
normalised (trim + Title Case) so it can't split into duplicates.
difficulty  optional: chunky | normal | detailed | insane (default normal)
On bake, tools/bake-weekly-mystery.mjs copies the entry into
puzzles/tags.json under the final id (the source of truth apply-tags reads)
and removes it from here. Underscore keys are ignored.
